Package org.drip.sample.munistate

Municipal Curve Construction and Jacobian
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    BenchmarkMoversCurve1_3
    BenchmarkMoversCurve1_3 illustrates the Calibration of the 1-3Y Constant Forward Yield Muni Curve using the Specified Suite of Municipal Benchmark Bonds.
    BenchmarkMoversCurve1_5
    BenchmarkMoversCurve1_5 illustrates the Calibration of the 1-5Y Constant Forward Yield Muni Curve using the Specified Suite of Municipal Benchmark Bonds.
    BondBenchmarkCurve1_3
    BondBenchmarkCurve1_3 illustrates the Calibration of the 1-3Y Constant Forward Yield Muni Curve using the Specified Suite of Municipal Benchmark Bonds.
    KalotayWilliamsFabozziCurve
    KalotayWilliamsFabozziCurve illustrates the Construction and Jacobian of a Bootstrapped Muni-curve using the Grid Layout as in Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993).
    MSRBCurve
    MSRBCurve illustrates the Construction of the MSRB Muni Curve and its eventual Grid Layout as in Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993).
    OASTermStructure
    OASTermStructure illustrates the Construction of the OAS Term Structure from Bond Prices using the Grid Layout in Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993).
    YieldSpreadCalibration
    YieldSpreadCalibration illustrates the Yield Basis Calibration using the Grid Layout as in Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993).
